guide.frontierhunts.welcome.settings: Graphics: Frontier Hunts starts on its Ultra look. Press %s any time for the Frontier visual settings.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.rules.title: Licence, tag and knife
firsthunt.frontierhunts.rules.before: Carry a Hunting Licence and a Deer Tag for this season, and only hunt deer while the season is open. A deer taken without them is poaching: the game warden fines you, and on Strict servers also takes half the meat and the trophy.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.rules.get.head: Getting your licence and tag
firsthunt.frontierhunts.rules.get: Pass the Ranger Academy archery course (press %s for the ranger assignments) and the Academy gives you a free Hunting Licence. In later seasons you claim it free at any ranger counter. New hunters can also take the free starter permit on this page. Otherwise buy them at a ranger counter: an expedition board, contract board, lodge stores, ranger window or camp post.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.rules.tag.head: After the kill: tag it
firsthunt.frontierhunts.rules.tag: Walk up to the deer, hold your Deer Tag and use it on the deer (%s). Do it within 3 minutes of reaching it and before you walk 48 blocks away, or the warden fines you for an untagged kill. A second offence suspends your licence.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.rules.knife.head: Then skin it with the knife
firsthunt.frontierhunts.rules.knife: Hold the Contour Skinning Knife, use it on the deer (%s) and stay beside it until the bar fills. Without the knife nothing happens and nothing drops. No knife? Craft one from an iron ingot, a stick and leather.
licence.frontierhunts.down.tag: Walk up to your %1$s, hold your %2$s and use it on it within 3 minutes (or the warden fines you).
licence.frontierhunts.down.no_tag: You carry no %2$s: skinning this %1$s counts as poaching (warden fine). Tags are sold at ranger counters.
licence.frontierhunts.down.knife: Then hold the Contour Skinning Knife and use it on the animal until skinning finishes: nothing drops without it.
licence.frontierhunts.down.no_knife: To skin it you need a Contour Skinning Knife (craft: iron ingot, stick, leather): nothing drops without it.
licence.frontierhunts.tagged.next: Tagged. Now hold the Contour Skinning Knife and use it on the animal; stay beside it until skinning finishes.
licence.frontierhunts.tag.reminder: Tag it now: hold your %s and use it on the animal. Then skin it with the Contour Skinning Knife.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.licence.route_ca: Buy a licence and a deer tag at the hunting camp's ranger counter at %s, %s (%s blocks away) or any ranger counter. Free licence: pass the Academy archery course.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.licence.route: Buy a licence and a deer tag at any ranger counter (expedition board, contract board, lodge stores, ranger window, camp post). Free licence: pass the Academy archery course.
